name: Plant OEE Rollup (SQL DataFlow)
description: Rolls up daily OEE metrics by plant + line using a SQL DataFlow. Demonstrates the SQL path (captured + flagged for hand-translation).
sql: SELECT plant_id, line_id, AVG(availability) AS avg_availability, AVG(performance) AS avg_performance, AVG(quality) AS avg_quality, AVG(availability * performance * quality) AS avg_oee FROM oee_daily WHERE reading_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY plant_id, line_id
